tool_args.rationale: The two acquired observations span sink gradients 0.18 to 2.35, resolving the narrow-pilot gradient ambiguity. Numerically fit the archived sink-coupled candidates and submit the best-fitting one for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fixed-rho siphon with square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archived rho range describes other sources; fitting rho avoids imposing an unsupported cross-source parameter constraint. Both branch forms remain candidates.

considered_alternatives.option: Cooperative Hill inhibition and barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not discarded: both are fitted alongside the simpler siphon and selected only if their residual is lower.
The sink-gradient probe addresses the identified ambiguity; the pilot signatures and archive point first to static sink-coupled mechanisms rather than a coupled ODE.
It does not discriminate the candidate mechanisms.
